content.question_text: What are the risks of configuring the transport with a static HttpRequest.Builder that contains a never-expiring token, versus using per-request HTTP request customizers, and what is the correct approach when dynamic authentication is needed?
content.answer_text: A static HttpRequest.Builder applies the same hardcoded configuration (including any token) to every request permanently. Prefer per-request customizers for short-lived tokens and least-privilege enforcement; reserve a static builder only for truly static, non-rotating values.

The client must call rootsListChangedNotification so the server can obtain the current roots list and understand which directories and files it may access.
